personal.leakLine: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: "Something for your file on us. Don't ask where it came from."

collective.warn: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: "Between us: we're planning %s, %s. I didn't say."
collective.truce: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: "If you want this ended, talk to me. Quietly."

firm.warn: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: "Off the record: %s, %s. Not from me."
firm.truce: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: "There's a back door to the table. I can hold it open."

guild.truce: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: "A private settlement can be arranged. Come through me."

network.warn: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: "You didn't hear it here: %s, %s."

conclave.truce: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: "The chamber need not know we spoke. Terms can be discussed."

inc_defection.notice: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: I need to talk to you. Not here. Not as one of theirs.

inc_succession.notice: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: There's been a change at the top. You'll want to hear it from us.

inc_raided_revenge.notice: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: Heard what happened to your vein. We could make them regret it.

inc_war_courting.notice: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: There's a war on. We'd like a word before the other side gets one.

inc_truce_expiring.notice: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: Our truce runs out soon. Worth talking about what happens next.

inc_turf_flip_fallout.notice: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: The streets changed hands. You should hear it from us.
